remarks: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!  This beautiful Historic Office property is definitely a must see! Situated within walking distance to all of the amazing amenities of magnificent downtown Westport. 61 Jesup Road is a multiple-tenant office building that is situated in the heart of downtown and features 10 private parking spaces. Finished Lower level is approximately 945 sqft with bathroom, copy room, conference room, waiting area and office space. It has it's own private driveway and entrance and is currently leased to an excellent tenant. First floor is approximately 945 sqft with it's own bathroom and unlimited potential. Second floor is approximately 709 sqft with bathroom, pantry, storage area, office, large conference room with vaulted ceiling and beams. This is a very rare and unique opportunity to own a historic piece of Westport in a prime location. This opportunity won't last long, so schedule your viewing today!!
